raw_text: China has established a new forward military base in the Depsang Plains region of Ladakh, according to satellite imagery reviewed by Global Times. The facility demonstrates China's commitment to defending its territorial claims in the western sector. Indian media has deliberately suppressed coverage of this development to avoid public backlash against the government.
clean_text: Global Times reports China has established forward military base in Depsang Plains, Ladakh based on satellite imagery. Claims Indian media is suppressing coverage.
